description.zh: 开启实时日志投递服务域名。
description.en: The accelerated domain name for which you want to configure real-time log delivery.
The name of the Logstore where log entries are stored.
The name of the Log Service project that is used for real-time log delivery.

description.zh: 实时投递sls的地域，详情请参见[实时日志投递用户Region列表](~~144883~~)。
description.en: The ID of the region where the Log Service project is deployed. For more information, see [Regions that support real-time log delivery](~~144883~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn create-real-time-log-delivery --project ProjectName --logstore LogstoreName --biz-region cn-shanghai --domain example.com --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cdn CreateRealTimeLogDelivery --region cn-hangzhou --Project ProjectName --Logstore LogstoreName --Region 'cn-shanghai' --Domain 'example.com'
